problem_statement: dns_msg skips unknown DNS records, but the RDLENGTH field (2 bytes) was only added to the parse offset when the record was NOT skipped. This caused the parser to start the next record 2 bytes short when skipping, corrupting all subsequent record parsing. The bug manifests when resolving hosts behind DNS64 that return CNAME chains with mixed record types.
build_command: make -C tests/unittests BOARD=native clean all UNIT_TESTS=tests-dns_msg
